title: Quick-hit list — 2026-03-17
content:
TODAY (Tue 17 Mar) - brain-dump / micro plan

Top 3 (must finish):
- [ ] tidy up PR review + merge notes for PR #452 (github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/452) -- leave short followup comment for @samir
- [ ] triage INF-3421 (autoscale flapping on dedicated pool) -> add logs to ticket, link metric graph, assign to ops oncall
- [ ] draft short runbook blurb for oncall handoff (15 min) — copy to confluence: conf.redwood/handbook/oncall-daily (placeholder)

Morning quicks (pre-stand)
- check Dedicated capacity dashboard (latency spikes last 02:00-03:00 PT?)
- revert noisy alert (svc:batch-inference) if false positive

Meetings / timeboxed slots
- 09:30–10:00 deep work: finish PR comments
- 10:15 sync w/ infra (15m) - confirm kernel selection experiments timeline
- 12:30 lunch + 1:1 w/ Emma (skip if rescheduled)
- 15:00 spike: run small quantization trial on g5x (quick notes: 8-bit, perf baseline)

Errands / personal
- [ ] pick up dry cleaning (drop before 18:00)
- [ ] send birthday note to Maya (weekend gift ideas: book, local coffee)
- [ ] dentist appointment Thurs 2026-03-19 11:45 (confirm via portal)

Random notes to self / thoughts
- batching profile looks different for short prompts (<64 tokens) vs long; might need dynamic batching rule per route
- consider exposing a "prefer-latency" flag on the SDK to opt-out of auto-batching in critical paths
- remind product to include quantization recommendation in the Optimize UI (small blurb + link to eval)

Loose links / artifacts to attach later:
- Jira: INF-3421, RGW-2313 (rollout plan)
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/452
- Confluence draft: conf.redwood/notes/quantize-spikes (placeholder)

Quick backlog (if time):
- tidy developer onboarding doc (reduce steps, add docker-compose quickstart)
- sketch promo blurb for Dedicated performance numbers (latency vs cost)

Questions for later / unresolved
- do we automatically fallback to fp16 variant when quantized model degrades quality? (check rollout policy)
- who owns the kernel selection matrix? (ask @emma)

Tiny wins/metrics to log today
- add one sample to eval set for the new model variant
- record baseline tokens/sec for g5x single-client run

End-of-day 1-line
- write 1-sentence summary for #eng-standup: what I moved forward + any blockers
